SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--LINKMYROWDATA DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = '#LINKFUNC.GETLANX3#'; DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30)=N'%{1}%'; DECLARE @ITM NVARCHAR(100)='%{2}%';
SELECT TOP 500 MFI.MFGNUM_0 工单编号 ,MFI.MFGLIN_0 行 ,MFI.ITMREF_0 产品编码 --,Isnull(B.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品名称 ,ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) AS 产品描述1 ,ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0) AS 产品描述2 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 AS REAL) 计划数量 ,CAST(MFI.CPLQTY_0 AS REAL) 已入数量 ,CAST(ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) 未提交数量 ,CAST(MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 - ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) AS REAL) 可入库数量 ,ITM.STU_0 单位 /* ,(SELECT TOP 1 LOC_0 FROM MFGMAT WHERE MFGNUM_0 = MFI.MFGNUM_0) 产线库位 */ ,ITF.DEFLOC_3 产线库位 ,CASE WHEN ITF.QUAFLG_0 = 1 THEN 'A' ELSE 'Q' END AS 存货状态 ,MFI.MFGFCY_0 生产地点 ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) > 0 THEN N'E02' WHEN MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 > 0 AND MFI.CPLQTY_0 > 0 THEN N'A02' ELSE 'C01' END AS ROW_BACKCOLOR2 ,CASE WHEN ITM.SERMGTCOD_0 >1 THEN '1' ELSE '' END AS SERQTY ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0) <> 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:待提交,en:Submit,de:Zu übermitteln}' WHEN MFI.EXTQTY_0 - ISNULL(MFI.CPLQTY_0, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(MFI.CPLQTY_0, 0) <> 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:部分入库,en:Partial,de:Teilweise}' WHEN MFI.EXTQTY_0 - ISNULL(MFI.CPLQTY_0, 0) = 0 THEN N'lang:{zh:入库完成,en:Completed,de:Fertiggestellt}' ELSE N'lang:{zh:待入库,en:To archived,de:Fürs Archiv}' END AS 入库状态 FROM MFGITM MFI INNER JOIN MFGHEAD H ON H.MFGNUM_0 = MFI.MFGNUM_0 INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON ITM.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMFACILIT ITF ON ITF.STOFCY_0 = MFI.MFGFCY_0 AND ITF.ITMREF_0 = MFI.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT MFGNUM_0 ,VCRLIN_0 ,SUM(UOMCPLQTY_0) UOMCPLQTY_0 FROM XWSMKI WHERE RPFLG_0 <> 3 GROUP BY MFGNUM_0 ,VCRLIN_0) XWI ON XWI.MFGNUM_0 = MFI.MFGNUM_0 AND XWI.VCRLIN_0 = MFI.MFGLIN_0 WHERE ( MFI.EXTQTY_0 - MFI.CPLQTY_0 ) > 0 AND H.MFGSTA_0 = 1 AND MFI.MFGFCY_0 = @FCY AND MFI.MFGNUM_0 LIKE @MFGNUM AND ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE @ITM ORDER BY ISNULL(XWI.UOMCPLQTY_0, 0)DESC ,MFI.MFGNUM_0
SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM XWSMKI WHERE RPFLG_0<>3 AND USERID_0='#LOGIN_USER#' AND MFGNUM_0='#工单编号#'
